a: nm:rebecca mother of michael max fleming

items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: my mother taught me as a six-year-old at the piano she would rehearse an imaginary choir

ctx.x: I mean, because some people really know by the time they’re in fourth or fifth grade what they want to do, and often times it’s musicians. But some people, it’s later in life that they sort of fall into it. So I’m basically wondering, when did you take the path?

Okay. My first instrument was piano and I just realized that in my community, as six year olds we had a band. All right. Later I went to accordion. When I went to accordion I had fantasies and visions of playing in front of people. And I just had visions of myself doing that.
